warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 3.00 + 3.00 + 2.00 + 2.25 (10.25). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, both S-02 views, S-03, A-07 (x) and A-08 (y). Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

The two S-02 plan views print DIFFERENT split ticks in bay 2-3: ground floor 1.30 + 1.70 (beam at 4.30, between slabs S1 and S2) and second floor 1.20 + 1.80 (beam at 4.20, between PS and S2). Both are kept as separate lines 2'' (4.20) and 2''' (4.30) — 0.10 apart, each carries its own beam, not one edge printed twice.
y 4.80 (B + 1.80, printed on both S-02 views) carries the second-floor B2 beam B''2-B''3; named B'' because the Truss T1 panel point 4.00 (S-04) comes first in the B gap.

Truss panel chains on S-04 (T1 8 x 1.000 D->A, T2 / T3 6 x 1.000 along 1-3, T4 1.125 + 1.125 D-E) became lines per section 4 rule 4. T1's elevation reads D at the left end (T3 label) and A at the right (T2 sits 5.00 from the left = row B), so the chain is recorded D->A.

D-E gap holds three distinct ticks: 8.90 (A-08 chain E-D = 1.35 + 0.90), 9.00 (S-03 main-roof edge D + 1.00) and 9.125 (T4 panel point). 0.10 / 0.125 apart and each from its own printed chain, so all three are lines (D', D'', D''').

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-07/A-08). The three 'ระดับหลังคา' levels share one printed label, so the value is kept in their ids. Beam levels on S-02 are printed only as 'ระดับ ±0.00' on the ground-floor B1 beams.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-04 plus A-07/A-08 (building sections, for levels and the 8.90 tick). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03..A-06 plans and elevations, A-09 stair, A-10, A-11, E-01..E-02, SN-01..SN-03) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-05..S-07 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, footing depths, section sizes, slab thicknesses, truss depths), which stay on their elements.
